org.portico.impl.hla1516e

Class Rti1516eFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.impl.hla1516e.Rti1516eFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    hla.rti1516e.RtiFactory

    public class Rti1516eFactory
extends Object
implements hla.rti1516e.RtiFactory
    Factory to create and return new Portico 1516e RTIambassador implementations and provide various other useful information about the RTI.

    To actually create an RTI, you need to first get the RtiFactoryFactory, from which you can get an implementation of RtiFactory (this class). You can then get your ambassador from there.

      • rtiName

        public String rtiName()
        Specified by:
        rtiName in interface hla.rti1516e.RtiFactory
        Returns:
        The string "portico". This is used when code specifically requests an RtiFactory by name. The RtiFactoryFactory will look through all the availabe service providers and ask each what its name is via a call to this method, returning the first to match the requested name.
